thread:
Maria: Quick kickoff — launch preflight for the benchmark post + webinar landing. Need a compact SEO checklist covering keywords, schema, internal linking, and redirects. Who can own which piece?
Elaine: I can own keywords + structured data. Will run a quick SERP gap vs competitors and send a prioritized keyword list by EOD. :mag:
Noah: I’ll map inbound routing and UTM conventions. Need final webinar slug from copy team.
Sam: I’ll do an internal-link audit across blog + docs and surface any orphaned pages. Found a few already.
Maria: Priorities: 1) redirect map for legacy benchmark pages, 2) JSON-LD for webinar & benchmarks, 3) canonical/rel=canonical checks, 4) internal link targets for CTAs, 5) UTM mapping -> HubSpot forms. Also make sure OG/titles are set for social/webinar cards.
Elaine: Starting schema draft for the webinar — FYI paste: 
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Benchmarking Latency & Cost",
  "startDate": "2026-04-14T10:00:00-07:00",
  "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/benchmark-latency-cost",
  "description": "Live demo + benchmarks, Q&A on inference economics.",
  "organizer": {"@type": "Organization","name": "Redwood Inference","url": "https://redwood.ai"}
}
```
Use that as base and we’ll add image and location.
Sam: Small tech note — the blog list currently points to /posts/old-benchmark with a 302. Recommend 301. I’ll file a redirect ticket: MARK-RED-451.
eng-runtime-bot: preview-checker: link preview failure for /webinar/2026-04-redwood-latency -> 500. @eng-runtime please investigate.
Noah: UTM proposal: utm_source=rw_marketing, utm_medium=web, utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_v1. Also adding utm_content for variant A/B. Will share tracking sheet and HubSpot mapping.
Maria: Timeline idea: today -> redirect map + initial keyword list; tomorrow -> final JSON-LD + meta tags; Wed -> internal linking sweep + GA/HQ test. Sound good?
Elaine: Need final H1s and meta descriptions from copy to finish the SEO titles. @Sam can you confirm H1s by EOD?
Sam: Yep, I'll update H1s and propose alt titles for OG. Also recommend adding rel=prev/next on the blog series pages to help indexation.
Maria: Perfect. I'll consolidate deliverables into a single checklist here and tag owners. Thanks all.
Maria: CHECKLIST (will update as things land):
- Redirect map for legacy benchmark pages -> Sam (create MARK-RED-451)
- 301s in place + nginx rule snippet -> eng-runtime
- Keyword list (priority + intent) -> Elaine (EOD)
- JSON-LD for webinar & benchmark posts -> Elaine (tomorrow)
- Final H1/meta descriptions/OG -> Sam (EOD)
- Internal link sweep & CTA targets -> Sam (Wed)
- UTM naming + HubSpot mapping -> Noah (sheet link incoming)
- Preview and social card check -> eng-runtime (fix 500)
- QA: staging crawl + Lighthouse check -> Maria/Noah (post-fix)

Sam: opened MARK-RED-451 with redirect suggestions and the 302->301 note. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MARK-RED-451
Noah: Uploaded tracking sheet (read-only): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example-sheet
Elaine: Uploaded keyword doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/2-keywords-draft — will ping when it's prioritized.
Maria: Great progress. If anyone hits a blocker shout here. Otherwise I’ll post the consolidated checklist update when ENG confirms redirect rules. :thumbsup:
